question.text: Under the PFUTP Regulations, 'Market Participant' includes:

answer.text: Any person or entity registered under Section 12 of the SEBI Act and its employees and agents
Only persons registered under Section 12 of the SEBI Act
Only registered intermediaries and their employees
All investors who trade in the securities market

explanation.text: The Logic: The PFUTP Regulations define 'Market Participant' to include any person or entity registered under Section 12 of the SEBI Act and its employees and agents. Option A captures this full definition. The Trap: Options B and C are too narrow — option B omits employees and agents, and option C limits the definition to "intermediaries" rather than persons registered under Section 12. Option D is too broad because not all investors are market participants under this definition. Note: Source-backed to NISM-Series-III-A workbook (Dec 2025), page 146.
